turns.text: I fixed the bug, and all 312 tests now pass. `LRUCache.__delitem__` (in `src/cachetools/__init__.py`) removed the entry from the cache but never removed its key from the internal `__order` list that tracks least-recently-used order. That left stale keys behind, so a later eviction picked a key that was no longer in the cache and raised `KeyError`. I added `del self.__order[key]` after the base-class delete so the two stay in step.
